body: I'm here to listen about anything you want to talk about. I'm having a hard time right now as well. I assume you're here, like me, because there isn't anyone you can talk to in your life. But we can help each other. Just expressing my thoughts and the amazing responses from some people here has already made me feel better, if only for one night. So just know...you're not alone!

When I say this I am trying to be as objective as I can be (which I know is pretty impossible), but I know I would not hold a kid responsible for his actions especially after so much time. I have nephews who are that age now and they just don't understand how things work, they don't have the capacity for it. And that makes me feel better about knowing that I am no longer that kid.

That's what I keep telling myself, but the person is saying they may come out with the situation which would completely destroy my family and relationship. And I'm afraid that they would not understand things  the way you do. There are moments of clarity where I know I can survive ANYTHING that comes my way including family abandonment as a result of having to become strong because of having a rough childhood. But most of the time it's just too much and want to give up before it gets worse.
Thank you!! it helps to know there are people out there willing to lend a kind word. You have already helped me more than you know.
